headline: AI agents orchestrate bioinformatics pipelines with verifiable tool execution and…
label: Llm Agents For Computational Biology
summary: Recent preprints benchmark and deploy LLM agents across bioinformatics, screening, chemistry and breeding workflows, testing their reliability and added value.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the embedding of LLM agents within established computational biology and chemistry workflows, with explicit attention to whether agent behaviour is verifiable. OmicsBench grades agents on a 97-task, 662-subtask multi-turn benchmark against deterministic answer keys. CADS isolates the incremental contribution of LLM proposers over an LLM-free loop in sequential DepMap screens, using e-process based FDR control. Brieflow-auto places an agent over the Brieflow optical pooled screening pipeline for parameter tuning and config validation, while Magnolia orchestrates docking, molecular dynamics and quantum chemistry runs with tiered, human-validated persistent memory. PigGPA constrains tool execution through SHA-256 parameter contracts. BioMINTREL and the distributed Perturb-seq agents address cross-disciplinary problem solving and parallel analysis of large atlases. What distinguishes this set is that reproducibility, error control and execution provenance are treated as evaluated outputs, not only task accuracy.
